_comment: Photos supplied by the site owner (25 September 2026). Source and licence still to be confirmed in writing before public launch. They illustrate Ethiopian coffee culture and roasted coffee; they do not depict our exporter partners, their facilities or our team, so they are marked as illustrative. Imported by `npm run images:import`, which only fills empty photo slots and empty featured images. The two Seife’s photos come from partner Seife Tuuloskorpi’s brochure and show his operations at origin (not illustrative).
